reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically recalls evidence-grounded long-term memory into prompts and ingests closed-turn messages through a SodaMem daemon.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 自动检索 SodaMem 长期记忆并将已结束对话写回记忆存储。
summaries.en: Automatically retrieves SodaMem long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness prompts and stores messages from completed turns.

capabilities: Automatically retrieves memory context for each turn from a SodaMem daemon over HTTP
Ingests closed-turn messages into persistent memory storage
Sends configured user-scoped conversation data to an external daemon
Uses configurable API URL, API key, user ID, and token budget
